description: This file defines the EmployeeLanguageService class which provides service functionalities related to employee languages in the OrangeHRM system. It manages an instance of EmployeeLanguageDao and exposes a getter method for it.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguageService
classes.description: Service class for handling employee language data, manages EmployeeLanguageDao instance.

methods.name: getEmployeeLanguageDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmployeeLanguageDao, creating it if it does not exist.
